Sets the Always On display setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Always On is activated, your Apple Watch face will be visible even when your wrist is down.

Silent Mode mutes most Apple Watch sounds.

actions.name: Set Theater Mode
actions.description:
Sets Theater Mode on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Theater Mode mutes most Apple Watch sounds and limits display activity.

actions.name: Set Wake on Wrist Raise
actions.description:
Sets the Wake on Wrist Raise setting of your Apple Watch to on or off.

When Wake on Wrist Raise is on, the screen will wake when you raise your wrist.

actions.name: Set Water Lock
actions.description:
Sets the Water Lock setting on your Apple Watch to on or off.

Water Lock protects against accidental input when you use your Apple Watch in water.

actions.name: Change Background Sound
actions.description: Change the background sound that will play when background sounds is turned on. Background sounds mask unwanted environmental noise. Background sounds can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Increase Contrast
actions.description: Increase color contrast between app foreground and background colors. Increase Contrast can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Full Keyboard Access

actions.name: Set Head Pointer

actions.name: Set Live Speech
actions.description: Enable or disable Live Speech.

actions.name: Set Mono Audio
actions.description: Mono Audio enables the left and right speakers to play the same content. Mono Audio can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Motion Cues
actions.description: Enable or disable Motion Cues.

actions.name: Set Mouse Keys
actions.description: Enable or disable Mouse Keys, allowing the movement of the mouse cursor using the keyboard.

actions.name: Set Reduce Motion
actions.description: Reduce the motion of the user interface, including the parallax effect of icons. Reduce Motion can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Slow Keys
actions.description: Enable or disable Slow Keys, allowing the keyboard to avoid recognizing rapid key presses.

actions.name: Set Smart Invert
actions.description: Reverses the colors of the display except for images, media and some apps that use dark color styles. Smart Invert can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Sticky Keys
actions.description: Enable or disable Sticky Keys, making it easier to press keyboard modifier keys.

actions.name: Set Switch Control
actions.description: Switch Control highlights items on the screen to control through an adaptive accessory. Switch Control can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Reduce Transparency
actions.description: Improve contrast by reducing transparency and blurs on some backgrounds to increase legibility. Reduce Transparency can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Voice Control
actions.description: Voice Control allows you to use your voice to control your iOS device. Voice Control can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set VoiceOver
actions.description: VoiceOver speaks items on the screen. VoiceOver can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Zoom
actions.description: Zoom magnifies the entire screen. Zoom can also be enabled under Accessibility in Settings.

actions.name: Set Appearance

actions.name: Set Bluetooth

actions.name: Calculate Expression
actions.description:
Evaluates the mathematical expression in the given input text and outputs the result as a number. 

Example expressions:

7 + 7

8 * sqrt(5)

$8 USD in euros

7 feet in meters

actions.name: Set Cellular Data
actions.description: Sets the device’s Cellular Data to on or off.

actions.name: Choose from List
actions.description: Presents a menu of the items passed as input to the action and outputs the user’s selection.

actions.name: Choose from Menu

actions.name: Clear Playing Next

actions.name: Upload to CloudApp
actions.description: Uploads the input to CloudApp and returns the CloudApp URL.

actions.name: Comment
actions.description: This action lets you explain how part of a shortcut works. When run, this action does nothing.

actions.name: Optimize File Size of PDF
actions.description: Optimizes the file size of the provided PDF file by compressing its images.\n\nIf the images contained in the PDF are already compressed, this action might not have a measurable effect on file size.

actions.name: If
actions.description: Tests if a condition is true, and if so, runs the actions inside. Otherwise, the actions under “Otherwise” are run.

actions.name: Connect to Servers
actions.description: Connects your computer to the specified file servers on the network. For example, you can connect to SMB/CIFS, NFS, FTP (read-only), or WebDAV servers.

actions.name: Contacts
actions.description: Passes the specified contacts to the next action.

actions.name: Convert Time Zone
actions.description: Converts the specified date and time from one time zone to another.

actions.name: Correct Spelling
actions.description: Autocorrects the spelling of text passed into the action.

actions.name: Count
actions.description: Counts the number of items, characters, words, sentences, or lines passed as input.

actions.name: Create Playlist
actions.description: Creates a new playlist in the Music app, adding any items passed as input to the new playlist.

actions.name: Date
actions.description: Passes the specified date and time to the next action.

actions.name: Show Content Attribution
actions.description: Shows the Content Source of Input contents

actions.name: Wait
actions.description: Waits for the specified number of seconds before continuing with the next action.

actions.name: Delete Stored Content
actions.description: Deletes stored content for the specified name.

actions.name: Send via DeskConnect
actions.description: Sends the input to another device via DeskConnect. DeskConnect makes it easy to send web pages, documents, pictures, and anything else between your devices.

actions.name: Get Addresses from Input
actions.description: Returns any street addresses found in the output from the previous action.

actions.name: Get Contacts from Input
actions.description: Gets contacts from the result of the previous action.

actions.name: Get Dates from Input
actions.description: Returns any dates found in the output from the previous action.

actions.name: Get Dictionary from Input
actions.description: Makes a dictionary from the text passed as input. JSON (like {\"foo\": \"bar\"}), key-value pairs (like foo=bar&baz=biz), and XML-based plist are supported.

actions.name: Get Email Addresses from Input
actions.description: Returns any email addresses found in the output from the previous action.

actions.name: Get Images from Input
actions.description: Gets images from the result of the previous action.\n\nFor example, this action can get the album art of a song, or all the images on a web page.

actions.name: Get URLs from Input
actions.description: Returns any links found in the output from the previous action.

actions.name: Get Numbers from Input
actions.description: Returns numbers from the previous action’s output.

actions.name: Get Phone Numbers from Input
actions.description: Returns any phone numbers found in the output from the previous action.

actions.name: Get Text from Input
actions.description: Returns text from the previous action’s output.\n\nFor example, this action can get the name of a photo or song, or the text of a web page.

actions.name: Detect Language
actions.description: Detects the language of the text provided as input.

actions.name: Dictate Text
actions.description: Transcribes what you say aloud into text and passes the result to the next action.

actions.name: Dictionary
actions.description: Passes the specified list of key-value pairs to the next action as a dictionary.

actions.name: Dismiss Siri and Continue

Stops execution of the current shortcut, and outputs content. This action is useful when:

• Running a shortcut from Quick Actions in Finder on macOS. The output will be saved as a file alongside the files selected in Finder.
• Running a shortcut from Services on macOS. The output will replace the selected text, if applicable.
• Or, when running a shortcut from another location that supports output, like the command-line or the Shortcuts URL scheme.

No more actions will be run after this action.
